title: AutoClimDS: Climate Data Science Agentic AI – A Knowledge Graph is All You Need
testbed_rationale: AutoClimDS is an agentic AI orchestration framework and knowledge graph infrastructure for climate data discovery and automated scientific analysis, not a physical process simulation dataset or benchmark for training parameterizations.
pain_points: Fragmented climate data sources, heterogeneous file formats (CSV, NetCDF, HDF, JSON), and steep technical expertise requirements
Keyword search requiring researchers to know specific dataset and variable names
General-purpose LLMs hallucinate dataset names, fail to locate authoritative sources, and cannot construct valid programmatic retrieval workflows on their own
Authentication requirements, API rate limits, and intermittent endpoint availability that disrupt fully autonomous workflows
extraction_notes: The paper focuses on building an agentic AI system (AutoClimDS) integrated with a domain-specific knowledge graph to automate climate data science pipelines, replicating sea level rise and CMIP6/ERA5 temperature projection studies from natural language prompts.
